rows.name: Everything seems to be in order.

Whatever happens in Superbia, we still
have our duty to perform here.

I hope my family back in
Superbia is okay.

At a time like this, we have to see
our duty through.

Ah... What will become
of Alst?
We can't let Iira use this again...

That Divine Beast weapon from
Judicium... It had terrifying power.

Everything's clear! No movement from
Invidia since then.

I hope we can find a good use
for this Judician technology.

I wonder if this Divine Beast weapon
could be used to save people...

Can our Divine Beast...can this
world...even survive?

Being around this person is
exhausting...
